notes: Added two new Dashboard cards: "Service translation pipeline" (new services found in the last 24h, description/title translations waiting to be uploaded, how many are translating right now, and how many were auto re-translated in the last 7 days because their source changed) and "Telegram channel queue" (posts pending review, failed sends needing a retry, how many sent in the last 24h, and how many are due to send on the next check - plus a note if Telegram posting is currently disabled). Both link straight to their full queue page. Also folded Telegram's AI spend (text + image generation) into the existing combined "AI translation spend" dashboard stat, matching what the AI Costs page already covers.
